message.reasoning:
With only $170 I can't afford to build on Park Place and have no empty buildable slots anyway. I'm weighing whether to try a trade with p3 for Illinois, offering Kentucky and Indiana or maybe Pennsylvania Railroad plus Water Works, though they already refused once and may again.

Actually, simpler plan: mortgage Water Works for $75, giving me $245, then build a house on Park Place for $200, leaving $45. Risk is low since opponents have no monopolies yet, so I'll go ahead with mortgaging Water Works first.
